function.description: Open a .camproj project file, replacing the current document and clearing undo history.

function.description: Import a mesh model (STL, STEP or OBJ) through the app's importers. A name already used by a model updates that model. A STEP model too large to import at full detail, or one whose file's edges lie off their surfaces, answers with reduced_fidelity: how closely its surfaces are approximated, in mm - gouge checks against it are stricter, and its operations are refused at the post when it is too coarse to check; import it again with a larger facet_budget, or export the file again with a tighter tolerance, to clear that. A STEP closed shell that meshes open imports incomplete: reduced_fidelity then says incomplete and names the hole, and every operation on the model is refused at the post. notes lists what the importer changed, e.g. a STEP face wound against its neighbours that was flipped, by name, or a closed STEP solid wound inward that was turned outward.
function.name: import_model

facet_budget.description: STEP facet budget: the most triangles a STEP model may be meshed into (default 30000000). Raise it to import a large model at full detail; STEP files only.

name.description: Model name; defaults to the file stem.

path.description: An .stl, .step/.stp, .obj or Solidcraft .sc/.solidcraft file (a Solidcraft design imports its cached final body).

With summary, a short form for a small context window: no machine definition, and each operation lists only the fields changed from its defaults.
function.name: get_job

summary.description: Short form: omit the machine definition and the operation fields that still hold their defaults (default false).

function.description: Read currently selected entities, active setup, active operation, viewport pick mode (model, face, edge, vertex), and active geometry picks.
function.name: get_selection

function.description: Every operation kind with its parameter fields, JSON types and default values, and the tool kinds it accepts. kind or section lists only those kinds.
function.name: list_operation_types

kind.description: Only this kind, by key or label (e.g. "face").

section.description: Only the kinds of this section: Mill2D, Drilling, Mill3D, MultiAxis, Turning, Plasma, WireEdm, Sinker.

function.description: The built-in tool catalog: names and definitions add_tool can copy into the document.
function.name: list_tool_catalog

function.description: Add a tool to the document, from the catalog by name or from a full definition (the shape get_job shows). Assigns the lowest unused tool number in 1-99999 and starts with the machine's default holder unless "holder" says otherwise; one undo removes the tool and its holder.
function.name: add_tool

definition.description: A full tool definition (get_job's tool shape). Optional catalog keys part_number, vendor, coating, helix_deg (0-90) and notes ride it; unusable ones refuse the add by tool name. Optional cutting_data: [{material, rpm, feed, stepdown?, stepover?}] per workpiece material word (aluminium_6061, mild_steel, stainless_304, grey_cast_iron, brass, plastics_pom) or unknown (the tool's default row; added from its own rpm/feed when absent), feed mm/min, stepdown/stepover mm; a material twice, a non-positive rpm/feed/step or a stepover wider than the cutter refuses the add by tool name. The tool runs its row for the document material (else its unknown row); add_operation seeds a milling op's feed from a row naming the material in force (the active setup stock's, else the document's) and its stepdown/stepover from that row, each missing one from the unknown row.

holder.description: A built-in library holder for it ("BT30 ER20", or a taper's Weldon pick "BT40 Weldon": the bore for the tool's shank), or "none" for no holder body. Omitted: the active setup's machine's default holder (tooling.default_holder), when it states one and the holder takes the tool. The reply names the holder it landed with (holder, holder_from) or why the default was left off (note).

name.description: Tool name in the document; defaults to the catalog name.

function.description: Set the active setup's stock: a box, a cylinder, or a copy of a model, through the undoable SetStock. Optional axis (z, x or y) or angles_deg {yaw, pitch, roll} turns it; the simulation refuses a stock tilted off the axes, by name.

angles_deg.description: A custom turn in degrees instead of axis: {yaw, pitch, roll}, each 0 when absent.

axis.description: The direction of the cylinder axis or the box height (default z). x and y lay the stock on its side.

box.description: {dx, dy, dz} in mm; centered in XY, z from 0 to dz.

from_model.description: A model name whose mesh becomes the stock.

One undo step.
function.name: detect_holes

function.description: A model's recognised pockets and slots (closed or open pockets, straight slots with open, round or square ends): boundary, floor and top Z, depth, tightest inside corner, slot width and open sides. With create, adds the operation that machines one of them (a Pocket over its floor, or a Slot along its centreline). One undo step.
function.name: detect_pockets

create.description: Optional: the index of a listed feature to machine - adds a Pocket (or a Slot for a round- or open-ended slot) with its area and depths from the feature, one undo step.

name.description: Name for the new operation (default Pocket1, Slot1, ...).

tool.description: The document tool for the new operation (required with create).

function.description: Delete an operation and its cached toolpath.
function.name: delete_operation

function.description: Assign a document tool to an operation (the tool must suit the operation's kind).
function.name: set_tool

function.description: A model's, fixture's, or DXF profile's pickable features with stable ids: faces, edge chains, welded smooth faces and vertices on models, or sketch chains and layers on DXF profiles, in world coordinates.
function.name: list_features

compact.description: Short rows (id, name and the facts a pick is chosen by; counts in place of loops and bounds) for a small context window (default false).

kinds.description: Which feature kinds to list; default all model kinds or sketch chains and layers.

model.description: Model or DXF profile name (see get_job).

function.description: Set the features an operation machines (faces, edge chains, loops, or DXF sketch chains and layers with optional per-chain side and direction overrides) by list_features ids. One undo step; undo restores the previous source.
function.name: set_operation_geometry

picks.description: The features to machine, in order. For 2D Contour on DXF profiles, sketch_chain entries may also carry optional per-chain "side" ("inside"|"outside"|null) and "reverse" (boolean) overrides.

id.description: A feature id from list_features: face:0x…, chain:0x…, patch:0x…, vertex:0x…, sketch_chain:<hex>, or sketch_layer:<layer>.

model.description: The model or DXF profile the feature is on.

reverse.description: Optional direction flip relative to operation climb for sketch_chain picks on 2D Contour.

side.description: Optional per-chain side override for sketch_chain picks on 2D Contour.

function.description: Undo the last document change.
function.name: undo

function.description: Redo the last undone change.
function.name: redo

function.description: Generate toolpaths: one named operation (always regenerated) or, with no name, every operation that is not current when reached in program order, including operations made stale by earlier generations in this call. A refusal stops the call and names the operation.
function.name: generate

function.description: Verify the job without posting: per-operation status and findings (op, move index, kind, message, whether it blocks the post) plus the program-level post gate. "ok" is true only when the post would write: every operation fresh, the gate passed, and no operation's own warning blocking the post (those operations are listed under "held_by").
function.name: verify

function.description: Post the program to an NC file through a post processor (a built-in name or a .cps path; default the document's own). Returns the written files, or refuses with the reasons. between_setups chooses what the program does at a setup change (pause by default).
function.name: post

between_setups.description: What the program does where it changes setup (the part re-clamped): pause (M0, the default), optional-stop (M1), continue (run straight on), or file-per-setup (one NC file per setup). Set before posting as its own undo step; omitted keeps the document's choice.

post.description: A built-in post name (Fanuc, Haas, Siemens 840D, Heidenhain, Mazak, Tormach PathPilot, grblHAL, TinyG, LinuxCNC, Grbl 1.1, Doosan DNM, Makera Carvera, Mach4, Heidenhain Klartext, Fanuc Lathe, Tormach PathPilot Lathe, Tormach PathPilot Plasma, Generic ISO Wire EDM, Sodick Wire EDM (Mark 21), Sinker EDM (ISO)) or a .cps path.

function.description: Declare a new setup and make it active. With datum_from, it starts as a copy of that setup's stock and WCS placement. The first setup on a document without setups adopts the existing stock and G54.
function.name: add_setup

datum_from.description: A declared setup whose stock and WCS placement the new one copies.

name.description: Setup name; defaults to the next free SetupN.

function.description: Make a declared setup the active one: where new operations, stock and WCS edits go.
function.name: activate_setup

function.description: Place the active setup's work coordinate system: an absolute origin, or a point of the stock's bounding box (min/center/max per axis) plus an optional offset. Rotation is a unit quaternion [x, y, z, w]; omitted keeps the current one.
function.name: set_wcs

offset.description: Added to the stock_point, [dx, dy, dz] in mm.

origin.description: Absolute origin [x, y, z] in mm.

rotation.description: Unit quaternion [x, y, z, w]; omitted keeps the current rotation.

stock_point.description: A point of the active setup's stock bounding box, e.g. {x: "min", y: "min", z: "max"} for the top front-left corner.
